verdict.rationale: Wise documents first-party bulk capabilities for transfers. Batch groups manage up to 1000 transfers as a single unit, bulk settlement settles many transfers in one bank transfer, and batches can be funded from the multi-currency account or via ACH/EFT direct debit. Bulk support is evidenced only for transfers, so the broader 'many items' story is only partly covered. missing for 10: bulk operations beyond transfers (e.g., bulk recipient creation, bulk card issuance or controls), details on batch error handling and partial-failure behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of batch workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: A batch group is a named collection of up to 1000 transfers that can be managed as a single unit.
Bulk settlement allows partners to settle multiple transfers in a single bank transfer at the end of a settlement period.
Register and retrieve external bank accounts used to fund batch transfers via ACH (USD) or EFT (CAD) direct debit.
